donation_order_display_name.name: donation_order_display_name
donation_order_display_name.value: "donation_orders"."display_name" is null or (char_length("donation_orders"."display_name") between 1 and 40 and "donation_orders"."display_name" = btrim("donation_orders"."display_name"))

donation_completed_amounts.name: donation_completed_amounts
donation_completed_amounts.value: "donation_receipts"."status" <> 'COMPLETED' or ("donation_receipts"."capture_id" is not null and "donation_receipts"."effective_on" is not null and "donation_receipts"."gross_cents" is not null and "donation_receipts"."fee_cents" is not null and "donation_receipts"."net_cents" is not null and "donation_receipts"."gross_cents" = "donation_receipts"."expected_amount_cents" and "donation_receipts"."fee_cents" >= 0 and "donation_receipts"."net_cents" >= 0 and "donation_receipts"."gross_cents" - "donation_receipts"."fee_cents" = "donation_receipts"."net_cents")

expense_proposal_completion.name: expense_proposal_completion
expense_proposal_completion.value: ("expense_proposals"."state" = 'RUNNING' and "expense_proposals"."completed_at" is null and "expense_proposals"."result" is null) or ("expense_proposals"."state" <> 'RUNNING' and "expense_proposals"."completed_at" is not null)

policy_period_valid.name: policy_period_valid
policy_period_valid.value: ("fund_policy_versions"."period_start" is null and "fund_policy_versions"."period_end" is null) or ("fund_policy_versions"."period_start" is not null and "fund_policy_versions"."period_end" is not null and "fund_policy_versions"."period_start" <= "fund_policy_versions"."period_end")

receipt_ready_evidence.name: receipt_ready_evidence
receipt_ready_evidence.value: "receipt_suggestions"."status" <> 'READY' or ("receipt_suggestions"."proposals" is not null and "receipt_suggestions"."audit" is not null)
